baseline_data_verified.key_insight_Understand_vs_Easy_gap: 1,276 items at Understand level but only 536 labeled Easy. At least 740 Understand items are labeled Moderate-Easy or Moderate — these are the primary DL-031 candidates.
baseline_data_verified.key_insight_Moderate_excess: 1,226 items at Moderate (target 762) — excess of 464. DL-031 downgrades alone would reduce this but still leave 826 with no offsetting upgrades elsewhere.
baseline_data_verified.key_insight_Difficult_VeryDifficult_defi: 85 Difficult + 0 Very Difficult vs. targets of 635 + 254. Deficit of 804 items in the upper tiers.

detection_methodology.primary_approach: Automated Jaccard similarity between stem text and correct answer choice text
detection_methodology.stem_tokenization: Lowercase, strip punctuation, remove stop words, extract significant words (len > 2)
detection_methodology.correct_choice_tokenization: Same tokenization applied to the correct answer choice text only

indicators: Stem is one sentence ending in '?': 'What is...', 'Which of the following...', 'Under GAAP,...'
Stem contains no scenario (no company name, no dollar amounts, no dates, no person role)
Stem asks 'What is X?' or 'Which is Y?' where X/Y is an accounting concept
Correct answer is a single term or short phrase (5 words or fewer)

secondary_patterns.scan_result: ~96 raw hits across explicit connective phrases (grep scan). True DL-031 scope is far larger — most definitional stems use implicit definitional framing without explicit connectives.

secondary_patterns.finding: Pack E Section A (items 1-50) has ~60-70% textbook-definition stems: 'What is the primary purpose of the balance sheet?', 'Under U.S. GAAP, inventory is reported at:', 'The effective interest method results in:', etc.
secondary_patterns.confidence: HIGH — visually confirmed by stem sampling. Pack E is the highest-density DL-031 pack.

secondary_patterns.logic: Items with CognitiveLevel=Understand AND DifficultyScore=3 (Moderate) are DL-031 candidates unless the stem is an application scenario. If stem is a definition, Bloom's Understand + Moderate label is a difficulty inflation.

composite_detection_algorithm.step1: For each item, extract stem text and correct answer choice text
composite_detection_algorithm.step3: Check for definitional stem patterns (single-sentence, no scenario data, connective phrases)
composite_detection_algorithm.step4: Cross-reference CognitiveLevel (Understand/Remember = DL-031 candidate; Apply/Analyze/Evaluate = unlikely DL-031)
composite_detection_algorithm.step5: Scoring rule: if (J > 0.50 AND stem is definitional AND CognitiveLevel is Understand/Remember) → HIGH; if (J > 0.35 AND CognitiveLevel is Understand/Remember) → MEDIUM; else → LOW
composite_detection_algorithm.confidence: MEDIUM — NLP-based detection requires human (or build-time AI) review for borderline cases. Jaccard alone has false positives on numeric stems (where correct answer is a number and stem contains formula terms).

false_positive_risks: Numeric calculation stems: stem describes calculation method (high term overlap with answer if answer is a concept name, not a number)
Reverse-definition questions: answer choices are the definitions and stem asks 'which concept', making correct choice text long and overlapping with stem terminology
Multi-select items: correct answer is an array, not a single choice — Jaccard comparison breaks down
detection_methodology.implementation_note: Detection script should be a standalone Node.js script in scripts/ that reads pack files via Function constructor, extracts stem + correct choice, computes Jaccard, and outputs QID → score → classification.

estimated_scope.methodology_for_estimate: 1,276 Understand items minus 536 Easy items = 740 minimal bound. Add ~60-260 from Remember-level items and borderline Understand items with high Jaccard but borderline definitional pattern. Range: 740-1,000.

pack_distribution_estimate.Pack A: ~80 (mostly Section E definitional items + scattered conceptual items)
pack_distribution_estimate.Pack C: ~200 (large Unprocessed pool with template-generated conceptual items)
pack_distribution_estimate.Pack E: ~300 (highest density — 60-70% of Section A, significant portions of other sections)

estimated_scope.confidence: MEDIUM — precise count requires automated scan execution

downgrade_to_easy.profile: Pure definition-match. Stem IS a textbook definition. Answer IS the term/definition. No calculation, no scenario, no application required. Candidate matches term to definition.
examples: P1E-A-001: 'What is the primary purpose of the balance sheet?' → Answer: balance sheet definition
P1E-A-013: 'The LIFO reserve represents:' → Answer: definition of LIFO reserve
P1E-A-041: 'The effective interest method results in:' → Answer: constant rate description
downgrade_to_easy.action: Set DifficultyScore=1, Difficulty='Easy'. Zero content change. 100% safe — no learner-visible difference beyond difficulty label.
downgrade_to_easy.governance_note: Difficulty-only metadata change. No question_state impact. No certification-blocking properties. No DL-008/DL-026/DL-013 implications.

upgrade_stem.profile: Stem defines a concept but COULD be rewritten as an application scenario. Concept is testable at Apply level. Current stem is definitional but the underlying concept is complex enough to warrant a higher difficulty if framed differently.
examples: 'Which cost flow assumption results in the lowest net income during rising prices?' → Could become: 'Harbor Manufacturing reports rising raw material costs for Q3. The controller needs to minimize Q3 taxable income. Which inventory method should Harbor use?'

'Under ASC 842, a lessee classifies a lease as finance if:' → Could become: 'Northstar signed a 7-year equipment lease. The PV of lease payments equals 92% of the equipment's fair value, and the lease includes a bargain purchase option. How should Northstar classify this lease?'
upgrade_stem.action: Rewrite stem as application scenario. Keep current difficulty label (Moderate, score 3). Content change requires backup per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md, full six-dimension re-verification.
upgrade_stem.risk: Content change — requires accounting accuracy review, distractor consistency check, explanation alignment. Higher effort per item.

keep_current.profile: Definition-match format but distractor subtlety genuinely makes it Moderate. Rare cases where distractors are so well-engineered that even a definition-recognition question discriminates effectively. Also: borderlines where Jaccard is high but stem has enough context to argue for Moderate.
examples: Multi-part definitional stems where the correct answer is 'all of the above' and each sub-definition must be verified
Stems where ALL four choices are plausible definitions and only precise standard language distinguishes them
keep_current.action: No change. Documented as reviewed-and-kept in DL-031 remediation ledger.

scenario_isolation_downgrade_only.description: If all 600 downgrade-to-Easy items are executed without offsetting upgrades
scenario_isolation_downgrade_only.verdict: Easy explodes from 21.1% to 44.7% (target 15%). Moderate drops from 48.3% to 24.6%. Distribution is still wrong — now left-skewed with Easy overrepresentation.
scenario_isolation_downgrade_only.severity: HIGH — executing DL-031 downgrades in isolation makes the difficulty distribution WORSE, not better.

scenario_coordinated_rebalance.description: DL-031 downgrades paired with Moderate→Difficult and Moderate-Easy→Moderate upgrades

step_dl031_downgrades.source_tiers: ~400 from Moderate (3), ~150 from Moderate-Easy (2), ~50 from other

step_upward_recalibration.description: Upgrade items that genuinely require Apply/Analyze/Eval. Agents E/F recommendations target items currently under-labeled.

Easy_1.note: Still slightly over 15% target. Formula: 536 (current) + 600 (DL-031 downgrades) - 100 (Easy→Mod-Easy upgrades)

VeryDifficult_5.note: Still well below 10% target — needs dedicated Very Difficult authoring

scenario_coordinated_rebalance.verdict: Acceptable. Distribution improves significantly toward CAQS §6.1 targets. Very Difficult remains a gap requiring new question authoring.

impact_analysis.critical_conclusion: DL-031 remediation CANNOT be executed in isolation. The Easy tier is ALREADY over target (21.1% vs 15%). Adding 600 more Easy items would produce a 45% Easy pool — nearly 3x the target. DL-031 must be bundled with upward recalibration in a single coordinated sweep.

integrated_strategy.philosophy: DL-031 is correct in its diagnosis (difficulty inflation on definition-match items) but its remediation creates a distribution problem. The solution is to treat DL-031 as ONE component of a broader difficulty rebalancing initiative, not a standalone defect fix.

step_1_detect.action: Run automated DL-031 detection scan across all 5 packs
step_1_detect.method: Jaccard similarity + definitional pattern matching + CognitiveLevel cross-reference
step_1_detect.output: QID list with classification (downgrade/upgrade_stem/keep) and confidence score

step_2_classify.action: Build-time AI verification of each flagged item (sample-based for >90% confidence; full review for borderline)

classification_rules.downgrade_to_easy: Pure definition-match, no scenario, no calculation, 1-sentence stem, answer is term name
classification_rules.upgrade_stem: Concept could support Apply/Analyze framing but current stem is definitional. Stem rewrite would add educational value.
classification_rules.keep_current: Distractors create genuine Moderate difficulty despite definitional format, OR borderline case with <0.60 Jaccard

step_3_prepare_rebalance_bundle.action: Combine DL-031 downgrade list with Agent E upward recalibration list
step_3_prepare_rebalance_bundle.coordination_rule: For every ~3 items downgraded Moderate→Easy, upgrade ~2 items Moderate→Difficult and ~1 item Moderate-Easy→Moderate

step_4_execute_coordinated_sweep.action: Execute difficulty recalibration in batches that combine DL-031 downgrades with upward recalibrations
execution_order: 1. Batch 1: 10 DL-031 downgrades + 15 Moderate→Difficult + 5 other upgrades (≤30 items total)
2. Batch 2-20: Continue paired batches until DL-031 backlog cleared
3. Final batch: residual items + distribution audit
step_4_execute_coordinated_sweep.governance_compliance: All batches ≤30 items (Rule 5). Backup before each batch (BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md). Difficulty-only changes to downgrade items (no question_state, CorrectChoice, or content changes). REVISION_HISTORY.md entry per batch.
step_4_execute_coordinated_sweep.estimated_total_batches: ~20-25 batches for ~600 DL-031 downgrades + ~400 upward recalibrations

checks: Bloom's distribution aligns with new difficulty labels
step_5_verify_distribution.success_criteria: All tiers within 5% of CAQS §6.1 targets, OR documented explanation for deviation

very_difficult_gap.finding: Even with full upward recalibration, Very Difficult (score 5) will remain at ~2-3% vs. 10% target. The pool simply lacks enough items with Evaluate-level cognitive demand.
very_difficult_gap.recommendation: Dedicated Very Difficult authoring pass required — ~200 new items or stem rewrites for existing Apply items to elevate them to Evaluate. This is a separate initiative from DL-031 remediation.
very_difficult_gap.defer_to: Future content-authoring sprint, not S831 scope

recommendation: RECOMMEND DEFER AS STANDALONE — DL-031 remediation should NOT be executed in isolation. It must be part of a coordinated difficulty rebalancing sweep (S832 or S833) that pairs ~600 downgrades (Moderate→Easy) with ~450 upward recalibrations (Moderate→Difficult, Moderate-Easy→Moderate). Execute in ≤30-item batches per governance-guard Rule 5. The standalone DL-031 scan (Step 1 detection) CAN be run now as read-only to produce the QID classification list for the coordinated sweep.
decision: DEFER — DL-031 detection scan (read-only) authorized for S831. DL-031 remediation (writes) deferred to coordinated S832/S833 sweep.

risk_1.risk: Execution of DL-031 downgrades without upward recalibration makes distribution worse
risk_1.mitigation: Hard gate: difficulty write script must verify bundle composition (≥2 upward recalibrations per 3 downgrades) before executing any batch

risk_2.risk: Jaccard false positives on numeric calculation stems with concept-name answers
risk_2.mitigation: Filter by CognitiveLevel — items at Apply/Analyze are excluded from DL-031 scan regardless of Jaccard score

risk_3.risk: Pack C/D dual-block architecture causes scan to read wrong choice text for Jaccard comparison
risk_3.mitigation: Use boundary-aware object parsing (Function constructor), not forward-scan regex. Extract CorrectChoice from the same JSON object as Stem/Choices.

risk_4.risk: Batch size violations — difficulty-only changes on 600+ items exceeds governance guard
risk_4.mitigation: Batches of ≤30 items per Rule 5. 20-25 batches across multiple sessions if needed.
